title: ep.parse_timestamp
description: Emitted timestamp and matching instant of a raw `timestamp` value (EP-D1..D4). Accepted: a JSON number of seconds; a string holding a decimal number of seconds (sign, fraction and exponent allowed); an RFC 3339 date-time string with seconds and Z or an offset. Anything else (other strings, booleans, null or absent, objects, arrays) is the domain error `invalid_timestamp` field `timestamp`. `emitted_text` is the text of the JSON number written into the enriched record: decimal strings and RFC 3339 input truncated toward zero to whole milliseconds, JSON numbers passed through in the reference (corrected RBD-18: truncated too), shortest round-trip spelling without trailing zeros (EP-D2). `match_instant` is the instant used to choose the subscription, in UTC (reference: binary64 arithmetic for numeric input, so about half of all millisecond values land 1 ms early, RFC 3339 sub-millisecond digits kept; corrected RBD-15: the exact value truncated to whole milliseconds, EP-D3). `match_time` is the reference's matching time with its zone kept (DB mode compares its wall clock, EP-D4); it has no corrected counterpart.

x-kit-errors.when: the timestamp is not an accepted shape (EP-D1)

timestamp_json.description: Exact JSON text of the event's `timestamp` field; the text `null` stands for null or absent.

emitted_text.description: Text of the emitted JSON number of seconds (compared as text).

match_instant.description: Matching instant in UTC; omitted when beyond year 9999.

match_time.description: Reference only: the matching time in the zone of the input (wall clock used by DB mode).
